name: Latvia: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or sponsor are left empty, not invented.
Language is the one chosen for the document (Latvian by default; English where the Latvia overview accepts it; M2 on the English template).
Signature handling matches the Latvia rule for the document (only N1 is signed and dated before submission; M1 is dated).
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json; correct CTIS location.
Clear title, trial identifier, version and date where applicable.

LV-K1.check: Uses the EudraLex Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure template version 2.0 (mandatory in Latvia; submissions from 1 September 2026), uploaded under Recruitment arrangements, unsigned.
Describes identification, first contact, recruiters, pre-screening, consent discussions, time to decide and national variations.
Latvian Member State fields completed (national_fields v105, v108 and, where the pathway applies, v110, v114, v117, v121).
The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations; each 'yes' section is completed, each 'no' section says not applicable.
Minors: the 0-13 and 14-17 pathways, legal-representative authority and the minor's own written consent from 14 described; no universal two-parent rule without a legal basis.
Adults unable to consent: capacity assessment and the decision-maker order of the Law on the Rights of Patients described.
Healthy volunteers: identification, first contact, record access, pre-screening and who approaches volunteers described.
Emergency: each Article 35 condition, eligibility confirmation, objection and representative checks, documentation and subsequent-consent timing described.
Witness: alternative consent method, witness impartiality and signatures described.
Channel and purpose of every recruitment item (LV-K2) explained.

LV-M1.check: One dated CV for the principal investigator at each Latvian site, uploaded under Suitability of the investigator.
States specialty, workplace and position, professional certificate number and validity, and date, version and edition of GCP training.
GCP certificate not uploaded unless requested; only the principal investigator's CV submitted for this item.
Assistant filled only the trial fields; personal details come from the investigator.

LV-M2.check: English EudraLex Declaration of Interest template used (mandatory in Latvia), one per principal investigator, under Suitability of the investigator.
Identifies the trial, investigator, institution, relevant interests and date; interests answered by the investigator.
No separate signature unless ZVA or the assigned ethics committee requested one.

LV-N1.check: EudraLex Site Suitability Template (mandatory in Latvia), a separate one per Latvian site, under Suitability of the facilities.
Identifies the protocol title and the sponsor protocol number.
Describes facilities, equipment, procedures, staff and expertise for the protocol.
Lists off-site institutions performing trial procedures other than laboratories and centrally provided services (or states none).
Signed and dated before CTIS submission by an authorised representative of the healthcare institution or another appropriately authorised person in charge; signer identity correct.
Site name, principal investigator and planned participant number match CTIS, M1 and M2.

LV-O1.check: Insurer-issued certificate under Proof of insurance cover or indemnification, identifying the specific study.
Policy terms added when the certificate does not contain the conditions needed for assessment.
Civil-liability cover for harm to life or health caused by an act or omission of the sponsor, investigator or healthcare institution.
Limit per participant per event at least 48 Latvian minimum monthly wages (12 for a low-intervention trial), checked against the minimum wage in force when the insurance contract was concluded.
Where the format allows: insured participant number and the Latvian site names and addresses.
Understandable to the assessor; insurance wording in the participant documents matches.

LV-P1.check: EudraLex Compensation for Trial Participants template used (mandatory in Latvia), under Financial and other arrangements, even if no payment is offered.
Reimbursements, loss of earnings, payments or non-monetary benefits, recipients, amounts, justification and conditions stated.
Amounts and conditions identical to the participant documents, the draft contract and the site budget (LV-P2).
Payment schedule does not discourage withdrawal; screen failure, early withdrawal, investigator discontinuation and trial suspension covered.
Minors, incapacitated participants and breastfeeding women: only reimbursement of expenses and loss of earnings, no financial inducement.

LV-P2.check: A draft contract with each investigator and/or site and a draft budget showing the allocation for each investigator or site, under Financial and other arrangements.
Complete enough for ethical review; any removed commercial detail leaves the assessment possible.
No executed contract or signature required; reimbursement wording aligned with P1 and the participant documents.

LV-R1.check: Sponsor statement under Compliance with national requirements on data protection, confirming GDPR and Latvian law (national field r1_the_sponsor_declares).
Sponsor details match the CTIS application; responsible person and role supplied by the sponsor, not invented.
Consistent with the privacy sections of the participant documents.

LV-S1.check: EudraLex Biological Samples Compliance template (recommended) under Compliance with use of biological samples.

Sample types and amounts, responsible entity, locations, storage period, transfers, coding, future use, withdrawal handling and destruction or anonymisation covered and matching the protocol and participant documents.
Optional future use described and linked to the separate choices in the participant documents.
